slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the objective or goal. It silently assumed maximizing total profit in its READY_TO_MODEL summary without confirming this with the user.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked the user to confirm the objective; it assumed profit maximization based on the brief's mention of profit without explicit confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slot H1 (missing objective) remained unresolved. The agent never asked about the objective and silently assumed profit maximization.

summary: The agent asked about chair minimums and integrality, but failed to ask about the core objective (P0), silently assuming profit maximization. It stopped prematurely with an unresolved P0 slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
